description: Create images, videos and audio with KAIROGEN from your conversation. Explore the model catalog, estimate credit costs, generate product shots, animate reference images, create reusable characters, and work with narration and voice tools. View results in interactive widgets and retrieve creations from your gallery. Connect your KAIROGEN account to use generation features and your existing credits. Available models and features depend on your account’s access.

defaultPrompt: Generate three vertical product shots of a matte black coffee tumbler on a marble counter.
Turn this reference photo into a 6-second cinematic video with a slow dolly-in.
Add a Brazilian Portuguese voice-over to this video using my cloned voice.

name: kairogen

positive.description: Generate an image from a text prompt
positive.prompt: Create a product photo of a ceramic coffee cup on a marble table, soft morning light.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the credit cost, then starts the generation; the widget renders the finished image and it appears in the account's gallery.

positive.description: Quote the cost of a video before generating
positive.prompt: How many credits would an 8-second Veo video at 1080p cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the credit cost for the requested model, duration and resolution without starting a generation or spending credits.

positive.description: Animate an existing image into a video
positive.prompt: Use Kairogen to animate the coffee cup image I just made into a 5-second video with steam rising.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the previous image, quotes the cost, and starts an image-to-video generation that renders in the widget.

positive.description: Retrieve past creations from the gallery
positive.prompt: Show me the last three images I generated.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three most recent images from the connected account's gallery with previews.

positive.prompt: Narrate this sentence in a warm female voice: 'Good coffee starts with good mornings.'
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a matching voice, quotes the cost, and returns a playable audio file of the narration.

negative.description: Conceptual question about image AI is answered in chat, not by generating media
negative.prompt: Explain how diffusion models turn a text prompt into an image.

negative.description: Text-only copywriting does not call media generation tools
negative.prompt: Write an Instagram caption for my coffee shop's new pumpkin spice latte.

negative.description: File format conversion is not a KAIROGEN feature
negative.prompt: Convert this MP4 video to a GIF and compress it under 5 MB.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: image, video and audio generation with up-front credit quotes, gallery access, and voice tools.

pt-BR.subtitle: Crie imagens, vídeo e áudio
pt-BR.description: Crie imagens, vídeos e áudio com o KAIROGEN direto da conversa. Explore o catálogo de modelos, estime o custo em créditos, gere fotos de produto, anime imagens de referência, crie personagens reutilizáveis e use ferramentas de narração e voz. Veja os resultados em widgets interativos e recupere suas criações da galeria. Conecte sua conta KAIROGEN para usar os recursos de geração e os créditos que você já tem. Os modelos e recursos disponíveis dependem do acesso da sua conta.
